recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No follow-up source edit is recommended for FHIR-8082 unless the work group reopens the broader profile/package terminology policy.
issue_request: FHIR-8082 was a Published, Persuasive with Modification DSTU1 clarification asking profiling.html to explicitly document the semantic levels around implementation guides, packages, conformance resources, and profiles: IGs as publication-level artifacts, packages as use-case-level artifacts, conformance resources as individual resources, and profiling as the overall process.
initial_application: The Jira comment records svn revision 5531. The git-svn mirror commit 3d073195c6c4ccd8b5ef415d17227122a0fdd428, with git-svn-id build@5531, added a glossary table to source/profiling.html with Implementation Guide, Package, and Conformance Item rows plus profile/profiling explanatory text.
additional_context: The current source/profiling.html page remains in build scope through source/hierarchy.xml. Later terminology work changed the noun Profile from the older package/item usage to a StructureDefinition constraint: FHIR-16414 was Published with a resolution to move Profile into the table as a set of constraints represented as a StructureDefinition, and commits dc4b3b45af and 72187f66d0 applied that cleanup. FHIR-5585 is related background because it earlier renamed the old Profile resource to StructureDefinition and temporarily used profile for a conformance package.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/profiling.html already provides the requested layered distinction, and source/implementationguide explains that an IG is a published set of rules represented by an ImplementationGuide resource and distributed as a package. Restoring the original Profile = Package wording would now be wrong after FHIR-16414.

related_jiras.note: Earlier Published terminology issue renamed the Profile resource to StructureDefinition and used profile for a conformance package, providing background for the wording FHIR-8082 originally built on.
